title: Missing Security Headers / Clickjacking
description: The application omits recommended HTTP security response headers (such as Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options, and Strict-Transport-Security). Missing framing protection in particular allows the site to be embedded by a malicious page for clickjacking.
businessImpact: Low --- absence of hardening headers increases exposure to clickjacking, MIME sniffing, and injection attacks, typically as a contributing rather than primary weakness.
remediation:
- Set Content-Security-Policy with a frame-ancestors directive (or X-Frame-Options) to prevent framing.
- Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and a strong Referrer-Policy.
- Enable Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) on HTTPS sites.
- Review headers against the OWASP Secure Headers recommendations.
